details.description:
Mooz’ fresh and firm ORGANIC tofu is the perfect non-dairy healthier substitute to paneer or cottage cheese, made from organic soyabeans.
Highly rich in protein and low in fat, it can be used in making Chinese dishes, with sauté vegetable and in rolls. Replace paneer with tofu. Make tofu curries/ subzi, tofu paranthas, tofu rolls, tofu tikki in burger or sandwich, marinate and make tofu tikkas. Much more nutritious than paneer and chicken, higher protein and lower fat with zero cholesterol. #Good source of calcium, manganese, copper, selenium, protein, and phosphorus#Rich in vitamin B.
details.usageInstructions: Add small cubes straight into miso soups or salads. Cut the tofu into quarters, coat lightly in potato starch, and fry to make agedashi tofu. Roughly cut the organic tofu into chunks and add to a stir-fry, then mix vigorously into the rest of your ingredients with a spatula. It is a great meat alternative in vegetarian or vegan stir-fries. |

details.description: Vegetable tofu, also known as soy paneer, is a popular plant-based protein made from coagulated soy milk. It has a firm yet smooth texture and a neutral taste, allowing it to absorb the flavours of the dishes it is added to. Tofu is widely used in various cuisines, particularly Asian, and can be cooked in numerous ways, including frying, grilling, and steaming. It serves as a versatile ingredient in both savoury and sweet dishes, providing a satisfying texture and adaptability in recipes.
details.usageInstructions:
Add small cubes straight into miso soups or salads.
Cut the tofu into quarters, coat lightly in potato starch, and fry to make Agedashi Tofu.
Roughly cut the organic tofu into chunks and add to a stir-fry, then mix vigorously into the rest of your ingredients with a spatula.

It is naturally gluten-free and low in calories, being an excellent source of iron. It has a sour taste and is quite bland. It can be savoury, sweet, crunchy, or soft when prepared correctly. The tofu is usually fairly firm in texture. We bring to you an easy red chilli garlic tofu that you can now enjoy at home. It is a good source of protein, calcium and other minerals. Perfect Snack coming your way! Our Tofu bars soaked in licious flavours. Have it as it is or toss it in salads or heat on a pan and have it warm.
